title: Specify physical-frequency occupancy oracles
description:
Define the independent interval-accounting contract supplied to admission.01 and production ledgers. Count complete control, data, forwarding, retry, parity and acquisition emissions against physical frequencies or the applicable regulatory group. Specify overlap, rounding, aliases, restart and clock-correction semantics.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Produce independent semantic tables and arithmetic, not another production duty tracker. Expected results must not call the production ledger. Consumer dependencies point toward this handoff, never back toward admission.01. This analytical contract does not establish equipment authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-calculated interval traces cover exact limits and partial-window overlap. Under ordinary narrow FHSS, two 250 ms emissions on one physical frequency inside 20 seconds cannot both pass a 400 ms allowance. SF, index, plan changes and restart cannot manufacture new allowance. Cite each configured constraint.
